ctx.x: Yeah. Who did he play with?
Would you tell me finally he, uh... He played with the superior. Yeah. He finally jumped on a B-flat clarinet to tell me.
Yeah, Jimmy Noon sent him one. He showed me the clarinet, the Jimmy Noon. It was old Albert system. And it sounded very, very nice. Beautiful tone. Did you ever work with Jimmy Noon?

items.q: Big Eye Lewy was with Freddie

ctx.x: Then the next band went, Big Eye Lewy. He come along. Big Eye Lewy was with Freddie and, uh, and-and-and-and George Backe was with, uh, And, uh, George Fields was with Manuel.
